name: muyang-tools-frontend
description: MUYANG Task Map desktop and web workspace
author: Chen Muyang

scripts.build:live-sticker: rm -rf dist && VITE_DEPLOY_BASE=/live-sticker/ VITE_BUILD_OUT_DIR=dist/live-sticker npm run build && node scripts/create-task-map-entry.mjs
scripts.build:task-map-desktop: cross-env VITE_DEPLOY_BASE=./ VITE_BUILD_OUT_DIR=dist-desktop VITE_DESKTOP_TASK_MAP=true npm run build
scripts.desktop:pack:win: npm run build:task-map-desktop && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
